thread:
maria: hi all, accepted the org invite but getting 403 when cloning a private repo even though i'm on the infra team. set up 2FA and uploaded my SSH key. any ideas?

sam: welcome maria! can you run `ssh -T git@github.com` to confirm key auth?

maria: output: `Hi maria! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.`

sam: ssh looks fine. usually this is SSO/email mapping. check Settings > Emails and make sure your work email (maria@redwood.ai) is added and verified, then click Authorize on the org SSO page.

maria: added and verified work email, clicked Authorize SSO, retried clone and it worked :tada:

devex-bot: reminder: onboarding checklist item - verify corporate email for GitHub SSO.

sam: if you still need push rights ping infra-maintainers; org-level membership doesn't always grant repo write by default.

maria: infra-maintainers added me to infra-writers, push succeeded. thanks everyone!
